Common octopus
nodes.address: Phylum Mollusca > Class Cephalopoda > Family Octopodidae > Octopus vulgaris
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, tireless experimenter: it investigates everything by touch, solves problems for their own sake, and answers to no colony, pack or partner.

nodes.label: Western honeybee
nodes.address: Order Hymenoptera > Family Apidae > Apis mellifera
nodes.lore_note: The colony is the self: tireless provider, tireless communicator — a bee literally dances directions for her sisters — with every role in life assigned by the community's needs.

nodes.label: Red fox
nodes.lore_note: A solitary improviser living by wits: it experiments on every landscape, hoards ideas in the form of caches, and trusts no pack, plan or partner for long.

nodes.label: Common raven
nodes.lore_note: A playful debater of the physical world: it tests every object, teases wolves and eagles, invents games mid-flight, and treats every rule of the landscape as a hypothesis.

nodes.label: Western dragon
nodes.domain: Bestiary Highlands — the medieval bestiary country
nodes.address: Bestiary order of serpents > Draco, the Western dragon
nodes.lore_note: A solitary strategist on a century's clock: it hoards, watches, remembers every debt, and moves only when the pattern is complete — contemptuous of haste and of company alike.

nodes.label: Kitsune
nodes.address: Inari shrine network > the foxes of the mountain
nodes.lore_note: The trickster as improviser: shape-shifting is brainstorming with the body — every human encounter is an experiment, every illusion a hypothesis about what people want to believe.

nodes.label: Fenrir
nodes.address: The island Lyngvi, in the lake Amsvartnir — the binding-place
nodes.lore_note: A lone physical realist: he speaks little, tests the chain with his body, exacts the agreed price when cheated, and saves everything — every gram of strength — for the one moment action is possible.

nodes.label: Paimon
nodes.address: Ninth spirit of the catalogue; faced toward the northwest
nodes.lore_note: A teacher-king in procession: he arrives with ceremony, tunes his roaring voice to his audience, bestows knowledge and dignities — charisma organised entirely around developing and elevating others, on his terms.

nodes.label: Gabriel
nodes.address: Among the seven who stand before God; the Annunciation road: Jerusalem, Nazareth
nodes.lore_note: The quiet counsellor-messenger: he appears rarely, alone, at exactly the decisive moment, carrying meaning he interprets for its receiver — depth over noise, purpose over display, every visit private and pivotal.

nodes.label: The Grey
nodes.address: The night roads and bedrooms of the accounts; catalogued beside the Blue Book record corner
nodes.lore_note: Detached, analytical, endlessly observant: the accounts describe experimenters who collect experience and specimens with no visible social or emotional agenda of their own.

nodes.label: Gray wolf
nodes.address: Family Canidae > Canis lupus — CORE HUB of the wolf family of variants
nodes.lore_note: A cooperative long-game strategist: it organises a family into hunting roles, holds territory across seasons, and plays endurance against strength — leadership as logistics, in fur.

nodes.label: Bael
nodes.lore_note: A shape-shifting king who rules from invisibility and speaks hoarsely and rarely — power exercised by withdrawal and indirection, not display.

nodes.label: Agares
nodes.lore_note: Mild in appearance, a teacher of all tongues who fetches back runaways — an elder-mentor whose social gifts (language, reconciliation of the lost) sit over real destructive power.

nodes.label: Vassago
nodes.lore_note: A good-natured declarer of past and future who discovers hidden and lost things — quiet, far-seeing helpfulness rather than display or dominion.

nodes.label: Samigina
nodes.lore_note: A quiet scholar-accountant: he teaches the liberal sciences and tallies dead souls — systematic knowledge and a ledger, kept from a small, unshowy form.

nodes.label: Marbas
nodes.lore_note: A hands-on master of mechanisms and bodies: he causes and cures disease, teaches mechanical arts and reshapes men — the catalogue's engineer-physician, valued for what he can do.

nodes.label: Valefor
nodes.lore_note: A sociable, loyal familiar who leads his companions into theft — warm, present, pleasure-and-impulse led, with loyalty to persons rather than to rules.

nodes.label: Amon
nodes.lore_note: Great in power and most stern, a teller of past and future who procures feuds and reconciles friends — a commanding arbiter who works people and outcomes directly.

nodes.label: Barbatos
nodes.lore_note: He conciliates friends and the powerful, understands every creature's voice, and knows past and future — a socially attuned interpreter-diplomat arriving with a royal retinue.

nodes.label: Buer
nodes.lore_note: A teacher of moral and natural philosophy and logic who also heals — knowledge held for transmission and care, the mentor-physician pattern.

nodes.label: Gusion
nodes.lore_note: He shows the meaning and resolution of all questions and reconciles friendships — a quiet, far-seeing counsellor whose power is understanding rather than force.

nodes.label: Sitri
nodes.lore_note: He enflames love between men and women and arrives beautiful — a sensual, present-tense persuader whose whole office is desire and display.

nodes.label: Beleth
nodes.lore_note: A mighty, terrible king who is furious until protocol, rank and homage are exactly observed, then delivers on his office completely — order, hierarchy and fulfilment of the stated desire.

nodes.label: Leraje
nodes.lore_note: He causes all great battles and contests and makes arrow-wounds rot — a direct, physical instigator who acts on the field rather than scheming off it.

nodes.label: Eligos
nodes.lore_note: A goodly knight who discovers hidden things, foreknows wars and how soldiers will meet, and wins the love of lords — a strategic commander-courtier working plans and patrons together.

nodes.label: Zepar
nodes.lore_note: A soldier in red whose office is executed directly — women brought to love men and together in love — with the barrenness clause showing a blunt, consequence-heavy literalism.

nodes.label: Botis
nodes.lore_note: He reconciles friends and foes and tells past and future — a socially directed arbiter whose knowledge serves the repair of relationships.

nodes.label: Bathin
nodes.lore_note: A strong, practical mover: he knows herbs and stones and transports men country to country — capability and logistics over talk or ceremony.

nodes.label: Sallos
nodes.lore_note: He causes love mutually between men and women and appears peaceably despite a soldier's form — warm, reciprocal, harmony-directed social work.

nodes.label: Purson
nodes.lore_note: A great king who knows all hidden things, discovers treasure, answers truly on secret, divine and cosmic questions, and provides familiars — commanding scope delivered as authoritative answers.

nodes.label: Marax
nodes.lore_note: He makes men very knowing in astronomy and the liberal sciences and supplies wise familiars — a systematic knowledge-builder working through curriculum and delegation.

nodes.label: Ipos
nodes.lore_note: He makes men witty and bold and knows past, present and future — a quick, emboldening intelligence whose gift is spark and nerve.

nodes.label: Aim
nodes.lore_note: He makes men witty in all manner of ways and answers private matters truly, while firing cities with a brand — inventive, mischievous intelligence with a destructive streak.

nodes.label: Naberius
nodes.lore_note: He makes men cunning in all arts and sciences, especially rhetoric, and restores lost honours — a verbal, inventive advocate who argues reputations back into existence.

nodes.label: Glasya-Labolas
nodes.lore_note: He teaches all arts and sciences in an instant, knows past and future, causes love and invisibility — and authors bloodshed: a brilliant, fast, amoral generalist whose gifts and harms are equally effortless.

nodes.label: Bune
nodes.lore_note: He gives riches, makes men wise and eloquent, answers truly, and administers the dead and their sepulchres — a commanding provider-organiser of wealth, speech and graves.

nodes.label: Ronove
nodes.lore_note: He teaches rhetoric, gives knowledge of tongues and good servants, and wins favours with friends and foes — a socially fluent provider whose gifts are all about getting on with people.

nodes.label: Berith
nodes.lore_note: A crowned soldier who transmutes all metals to gold, gives and confirms dignities, and answers in a clear subtle voice while being branded a great liar — commanding, acquisitive power with a silver tongue.

nodes.label: Astaroth
nodes.lore_note: He gives true answers, discovers all secrets, teaches all liberal sciences, and declares the reason of his own fall — a solitary, systematic knower with a complete account of himself.

nodes.label: Forneus
nodes.lore_note: He teaches rhetoric wonderfully, gives men good names and tongues, and makes them beloved of foes as well as friends — a socially masterful reputation-builder whose medium is regard.

nodes.label: Foras
nodes.lore_note: He teaches logic and ethics in all their parts and recovers lost things methodically — a systematic moral reasoner whose gifts (eloquence, long life, invisibility) follow from mastery, not charm.

nodes.label: Asmoday
nodes.lore_note: He teaches arithmetic, astronomy, geometry and all handicrafts absolutely, gives true and full answers, and shows and guards treasure — a systematic, total mastery delivered without negotiation or charm.

nodes.label: Gaap
nodes.lore_note: He guides four great kings, switches men between ignorance and full knowledge of philosophy and the sciences, causes love or hatred, frees familiars and transports men between kingdoms — a commanding conductor of people, minds and loyalties.

nodes.label: Furfur
nodes.lore_note: He never speaks truth unless compelled in the triangle, raises tempests, and wittingly urges love — a bold, weather-making improviser whose honesty is situational, not principled.

nodes.label: Marchosias
nodes.lore_note: A strong fighter who endures his binding with a stated, patient hope of returning to the Seventh Throne after 1,200 years — a lone physical realist playing the longest game in the catalogue.

nodes.label: Stolas
nodes.lore_note: He teaches astronomy and the virtues of herbs and precious stones from a raven's form — a solitary naturalist-scholar whose knowledge spans sky and soil for its own sake.

nodes.label: Phenex
nodes.lore_note: A child-voiced poet who sings before he speaks, teaches the wonderful sciences willingly, and hopes openly for restoration — feeling and expression run the whole encounter.

nodes.label: Halphas
nodes.lore_note: A hoarse-voiced dove who builds towers, stocks them with weapons, and dispatches soldiers on schedule — pure staff-officer order, executed without flourish.

nodes.label: Malphas
nodes.lore_note: A crow-formed builder who sells enemy intelligence and good familiars, and cheerfully deceives anyone who tries to buy his favour with sacrifice — ingenuity with a trickster's terms of trade.

nodes.label: Raum
nodes.lore_note: A crow who robs kings, razes cities, abolishes dignities, foretells everything, and then makes enemies love each other — action first, categories nowhere.

nodes.label: Focalor
nodes.lore_note: A gryphon-winged drowner of men and wrecker of warships who stops the instant he is told to, and hopes to be restored in 1,000 years — lethal craft, absolute brakes, no small talk.

nodes.label: Vepar
nodes.lore_note: A mermaid-formed duke who convoys arms ships, conjures phantom fleets and storm seas, and kills by putrefying wounds in three days — patient, systemic, quietly horrible.

nodes.label: Sabnock
nodes.lore_note: A lion-headed soldier on a pale horse who builds and arms castles, hands out good familiars, and rots enemies' wounds for days — the garrison commander as a complete system.

nodes.label: Shax
nodes.lore_note: A hoarse-but-subtle dove who steals senses and kings' money (repayable in 1,200 years), fetches anything — and lies fluently unless the triangle forces truth.

nodes.label: Vine
nodes.lore_note: A lion on a black horse, viper in hand, who exposes hidden witches and futures, then builds towers or flattens great walls to order — revelation with a demolition crew.

nodes.label: Bifrons
nodes.lore_note: A monster-formed earl who becomes a man to teach astrology and geometry, knows the virtues of stones and woods, moves corpses, and lights phantom candles on graves.

nodes.label: Vual
nodes.lore_note: A dromedary duke who turns human to procure love and reconcile foes, telling past, present and future in imperfect Egyptian — warmth and omniscience, slightly accented.

nodes.label: Haagenti
nodes.lore_note: A winged bull who becomes a man to make men wise, turn every metal to gold, and swap wine and water at will — the teacher as alchemist, the alchemist as teacher.

nodes.label: Crocell
nodes.lore_note: An angel-formed duke who speaks mystically of hidden things, teaches geometry, conjures the sound of rushing waters from dry air, warms waters, and discovers baths.

nodes.label: Furcas
nodes.lore_note: A cruel, hoary old knight on a pale horse who teaches philosophy, astrology, rhetoric, logic, palmistry and fire-divination completely and perfectly — the syllabus is total, the manner is not kind.

nodes.label: Balam
nodes.lore_note: A three-headed king on a furious bear, goshawk on fist, who answers truly about all of time, makes men invisible, and makes them witty — terror in the form, reliability in the service.

nodes.label: Alloces
nodes.lore_note: A lion-faced soldier on a great horse, voice hoarse and huge, teaching astronomy and all the liberal sciences and bringing good familiars — the professor as cavalry officer.

nodes.label: Camio
nodes.lore_note: A thrush who becomes a swordsman, answers from burning ashes, disputes brilliantly, and teaches men to understand every bird, beast and the voice of the waters themselves.

nodes.label: Murmur
nodes.lore_note: A crowned warrior on a gryphon, trumpets before him, who teaches philosophy perfectly and constrains the deceased to appear and answer any question put to them.

nodes.label: Orobas
nodes.domain: Ars Goetia — the Princes and Prelates
nodes.lore_note: A horse who becomes a man to reveal all of time, answer truly about divinity and creation, bestow dignities — and stay very faithful, shielding his exorcist from every temptation.

nodes.label: Gremory
nodes.lore_note: A beautiful, crowned woman on a great camel who tells all of time, reveals hidden treasures and exactly what they lie in, and procures the love of women young and old.

nodes.label: Ose
nodes.lore_note: A leopard who becomes a man to teach the liberal sciences, answer divine questions truly, and transform men into any shape — complete with total belief that the new shape is their true one.

nodes.label: Amy
nodes.lore_note: A flaming fire who becomes a man to make students wonderfully knowing in astrology and all liberal sciences, grant good familiars, and betray where spirits keep their treasure.

nodes.label: Orias
nodes.lore_note: A lion on a strong horse, serpent-tailed, two hissing serpents in hand, who teaches the stars and planetary mansions, transforms men, and hands out dignities, prelacies and favour.

nodes.label: Vapula
nodes.lore_note: A lion with gryphon's wings who makes men knowing in all handcrafts and professions, and in philosophy and the other sciences too — the guild-master of everything.

nodes.label: Zagan
nodes.lore_note: A winged bull who becomes a man to make men witty, swap wine, water and blood, strike any metal into local coin, and even make fools wise.

nodes.label: Valac
nodes.lore_note: A winged child riding a two-headed dragon who gives true answers about hidden treasures and brings serpents to the exorciser without any force at all.

nodes.label: Andras
nodes.lore_note: An angel-bodied, raven-headed marquis on a black wolf, bright sword flourished, whose only office is sowing discord — and who will slay a careless exorcist and all his fellows.

nodes.label: Flauros
nodes.lore_note: A terrible leopard who becomes a flaming-eyed man to answer truly about all time, creation and the Fall — if he stands in the triangle; anywhere else, he lies about all of it, burns your enemies, and guards you from temptation.

nodes.label: Andrealphus
nodes.lore_note: A peacock arriving with great noises, who becomes a man to teach geometry perfectly, sharpen men in mensuration and astronomy, and transform a man into a bird.

nodes.label: Kimaris
nodes.lore_note: A valiant warrior on a goodly black horse, ruler of all spirits in Africa, who teaches grammar, logic and rhetoric perfectly and discovers lost and hidden things and treasures.

nodes.label: Amdusias
nodes.lore_note: A unicorn who stands as a man while trumpets and every instrument sound — eventually — who bends trees to the exorcist's will and gives excellent familiars.

nodes.label: Belial
nodes.lore_note: Two beautiful angels in a chariot of fire: a comely-voiced king, created next after Lucifer, who distributes senatorships and favour, gives excellent familiars — and answers truly only for offerings, and barely for an hour.

nodes.label: Decarabia
nodes.lore_note: A star in a pentacle who becomes a man to reveal the virtues of birds and precious stones, and to fill the air with phantom birds that sing and drink like real ones.

nodes.label: Seere
nodes.domain: Ars Goetia — the Princes and Prelates
nodes.lore_note: A beautiful man on a winged horse who crosses the earth in the twinkling of an eye, carries anything anywhere, makes things happen suddenly, reports theft and treasure truly — and is of an indifferent good nature, willing to do anything.

nodes.label: Dantalion
nodes.lore_note: A man of many countenances, book in hand, who teaches all arts and sciences, knows and declares everyone's secret thoughts — and can change them at will, cause love, and show any person's likeness in vision.

nodes.label: Andromalius
nodes.lore_note: A man holding a great serpent who brings back thieves together with the stolen goods, exposes all wickedness and underhand dealing, punishes the wicked, and discovers hidden treasures — the catalogue's closing act of restitution.

nodes.label: Lion
nodes.lore_note: A king who rules by vigilance and mercy: it watches even in sleep, hides its path from hunters, and its breath raises the dead cub — authority as protection, not mere force.

nodes.label: Tiger
nodes.lore_note: Pure velocity with one exploitable flaw: it chases at full speed until a false image stops it dead — action first, reflection only when tricked into it.

nodes.label: Pard
nodes.lore_note: A spotted opportunist of appetite: it takes what crosses its path and fathers hybrids — variety itself, worn as spots.

nodes.label: Panther
nodes.lore_note: A charisma engine: it does nothing but rest, rise and breathe — and the whole animal world follows willingly, while its one true enemy hides from the scent.

nodes.label: Elephant
nodes.lore_note: A gentle giant organised around protection: chaste, communal in rescue — twelve cry with it and a young one lifts it — and defined by one ancestral enemy at the water's edge.

nodes.label: Beaver
nodes.lore_note: The bestiary's great act of strategic renunciation: it knows exactly what the hunter wants, pays it once, in full, and lives — prudence performed as self-surgery.

nodes.label: Ibex
nodes.lore_note: A creature whose whole design is a fall survived: it lives where falling is fatal and carries its rescue on its head.

nodes.label: Hyena
nodes.lore_note: A shape-shifting mimic of the graveyard: voice borrowed, sex unfixed, diet of the dead — the bestiary's portrait of doubleness itself, clever and unclean at once.

nodes.label: Crocotta
nodes.lore_note: The hyena's lure perfected: it does not just copy a voice, it knows your name — personalised deception from a mouth of solid bone.

nodes.label: Bonnacon
nodes.lore_note: An engineer of the undignified exit: disarmed at the front, it weaponised the rear — survival by making pursuit unbearable.

nodes.label: Ape
nodes.lore_note: Imitation as identity: it becomes whatever it watches, and the lore's cruel sorting — the favoured child dropped, the clinging one saved — is its whole story.

nodes.label: Satyr
nodes.lore_note: Restlessness incarnate: it cannot be still, cannot be serious, cannot be tamed — appetite and gesture without an off-switch.

nodes.label: Deer (Stag)
nodes.lore_note: A pilgrim of renewal: it seeks out the serpent, takes the poison into itself on purpose, and pays for rebirth with its crown — and it migrates leaning, literally, on its companions.

nodes.label: Goat
nodes.lore_note: A surveyor on impossible ground: it goes high, sees far, and answers to nobody's path but the one its own feet verify.

nodes.label: Wild Goat (Caprea)
nodes.lore_note: A long-range risk analyst: its whole survival is one judgement, made early and at distance — friend or hunter — and it is never wrong in the telling.

nodes.label: Monoceros
nodes.lore_note: A single weapon and a single answer: everything it meets is pierced or avoided — purity of function, no negotiation module installed.

nodes.label: Bear
nodes.lore_note: Creation by patience: what it loves starts as formlessness, and only sustained, tongue-worn attention makes it a bear — care as a manufacturing process.

nodes.label: Leucrota
nodes.lore_note: Speed plus seduction: the fastest thing in the book also bothers to learn your voice — over-engineered predation, in the medieval telling.

nodes.label: Parandrus
nodes.lore_note: The invisible introvert: its genius is not to fight, flee or lure, but to cease, visually, to exist — camouflage as a complete philosophy.

nodes.label: Fox
nodes.lore_note: The bestiary's purest trickster: hunger produces theatre — a staged corpse, a held breath — and patience converts the audience into the meal.

nodes.label: Yale (Eale)
nodes.lore_note: A creature with a spare weapon and the discipline to hold it back: redundancy as strategy — it never commits both horns to one fight.

nodes.label: Wolf
nodes.lore_note: A professional of the night raid whose power is a contest of first sight: see first or be silenced — awareness itself is the weapon, for both sides.

nodes.label: Dog
nodes.lore_note: Loyalty with a healing tongue and one recorded folly: it gives everything to its master, remembers kindness forever — and can still lose real meat to a reflection.

nodes.label: Sheep
nodes.lore_note: Meekness as a complete strategy: no weapon, no flight plan — only recognition, of the one voice that is safety, in a field of threats.

nodes.label: Wether
nodes.lore_note: The book's quietest entry: a working animal defined by what was taken from it and the labour that remained — recorded at the source's own brevity.

nodes.label: Ram (Aries)
nodes.lore_note: Born to the front: it leads because it is first, strikes with the forehead God gave it, and belongs by name to the altar — authority and sacrifice in one animal.

nodes.label: Lamb (Agnus)
nodes.lore_note: Perfect recognition inside total innocence: in a field of thousands of voices it cannot be fooled about the one that is home.

nodes.label: He-Goat (Hircus)
nodes.lore_note: Appetite with excellent eyesight: it sees the whole mountain and wants most of it — the Pecora's id, set between the lamb and the kid.

nodes.label: Kid (Hedus)
nodes.lore_note: A mouth with legs and a future: it eats the tender world experimentally and is itself, the etymology shrugs, delicious — youth as appetite in both directions.

nodes.label: Boar (Aper)
nodes.lore_note: A cornered argument with tusks: it does not warn twice, and its answer to being hunted is to hunt back.

nodes.label: Bullock (Iuvencus)
nodes.lore_note: Strength in apprenticeship: old enough to pull, young enough to be named for the help not yet fully his — the Pecora's journeyman.

nodes.label: Bull (Taurus)
nodes.lore_note: Majesty measured in usefulness: the strongest back in the Pecora, and the strength is for the field, the herd and the altar — power entirely employed.

nodes.label: Horse
nodes.lore_note: A soldier with a heart: it loves the trumpet, charges on music, and then — the detail the compilers kept — weeps over the man it carried. Glory and grief in one harness.

nodes.label: Mule
nodes.lore_note: The professional burden-bearer whose line ends with it: all capability, no posterity — it works in the present tense only, and the account respects the fact without sentiment.

nodes.label: Cat (Musio)
nodes.lore_note: A night-sighted solo hunter with a cruel streak of play: it sees what the house cannot, and toys with the difference before it eats.

nodes.label: Mouse (Mus)
nodes.lore_note: A lunar footnote of an animal: it lives in walls and earth, timed — the compilers believed — to the moon, and mostly it is there to be hunted and to persist anyway.

nodes.label: Weasel
nodes.lore_note: A paradox with whiskers: it hears the word in one ear and births it from the mouth, moves house daily, and refuses to accept its children's deaths — doctrine and defiance in a six-inch body.

nodes.label: Mole (Talpa)
nodes.lore_note: A specialist of total commitment: it traded the sky for the soil, eyes for ears, and in its one element it is perfectly informed.

nodes.label: Hedgehog (Ericius)
nodes.lore_note: A supply-chain of one: it forecasts winter, harvests by rolling, transports on its own back, and delivers to the children — prudence with spines.

nodes.label: Ant (Formica)
nodes.lore_note: A civilisation in miniature: ordered columns, quality control on doctrine (wheat, not barley), and food engineering against the rain — foresight is its religion.

nodes.label: Dove (Columba)
nodes.lore_note: Innocence engineered by omission: no gall, no bite, a groan for a song — and its flocking trust is exactly what the hawk entry, facing it, is for.

nodes.label: Hawk (Accipiter)
nodes.lore_note: The taker, honestly named: what it is for is seizure — of doves, of season, of the falconer's glove — and the book neither hides nor forgives the function.

nodes.label: Turtle Dove (Turtur)
nodes.lore_note: A one-entry ledger of the heart: one mate, entered once, and if the page is torn out the book closes — fidelity as refusal of all sequels.

nodes.label: Pelican (Pellicanus)
nodes.lore_note: Love that escalates past death in both directions: rage, grief, then self-wounding resurrection — the most extreme emotional arc the bestiary gives any bird.

nodes.label: Night Heron (Nicticorax)
nodes.lore_note: A connoisseur of ruins: it has chosen the night shift and the broken places permanently, and the book reads the choice as character, not circumstance.

nodes.label: Hoopoe (Epops/Hupupa)
nodes.lore_note: Care with the direction reversed: the children become the parents' parents, and tenderness literally re-youngs the old — gratitude as a life-cycle stage.

nodes.label: Magpie (Pica)
nodes.lore_note: A voice in search of a subject: it says everything it hears, steals the shiny sentence and the shiny spoon with the same beak — talk as appetite.

nodes.label: Raven (Corvus)
nodes.lore_note: A recogniser by likeness: it loves what has become recognisably itself, postpones everything else to a croaked 'tomorrow' — and yet God and the prophets keep employing it.

nodes.label: Cock (Gallus)
nodes.lore_note: A preacher with a schedule and a guilty conscience built in: strike your own breast first, then announce the hour to everyone sleeping — authority that begins in self-accusation.

nodes.label: Ostrich (Strutio)
nodes.lore_note: The great forgetter with the magic gaze: it abandons its eggs to the sand and then — the lore insists — hatches them by attention alone, negligence and miracle in one bird.

nodes.label: Vulture (Vultur)
nodes.lore_note: Death's actuary: it computes mortality at three days' distance, follows armies as a futures market in carrion, and waits with a patience that has never once been wrong.

nodes.label: Crane
nodes.lore_note: The flock runs on rosters, reliefs and mutual support, with a leader who keeps formation by calling out the laggards — order, duty and logistics carried out gladly.

nodes.label: Kite
nodes.lore_note: A pragmatic opportunist working alone at the safest possible margin: it sizes up every risk, refuses the big ones, and takes the small ones quickly and without ceremony.

nodes.label: Parrot
nodes.lore_note: Expressive and quick, it greets strangers in two languages before it has been taught anything, soaks up words while it is young, and performs its learning for whoever will listen.

nodes.label: Ibis
nodes.lore_note: Self-sufficient and shore-bound, it handles its own purging, works its strip of beach day and night, and provides for its young entirely from what washes up or can be stolen from snakes.

nodes.label: Swallow
nodes.lore_note: A far-sighted maker: it reads buildings for collapse before men do, designs around its own missing hands with wet wing-tips, and quietly heals its young — insight poured entirely into home and family.

nodes.label: Stork
nodes.lore_note: Duty is its whole calendar: herald of spring, soldier-migrant, parent to the point of self-harm — and a child who settles the account exactly, caring for its parents as long as it was cared for.

nodes.label: Blackbird
nodes.lore_note: A solitary artist absorbed in its own music: it sings because the singing moves it, flies alone, and drifts through other creatures' stories as a beautiful, dangerous distraction.

nodes.label: Owl (bubo)
nodes.lore_note: A withdrawn cave-dweller with no filter and no schedule: it utters whatever fills its mind, avoids the daylit world's business entirely, and endures the mobbing its rare appearances provoke.

nodes.label: Bat
nodes.lore_note: A creature whose one recorded virtue is devotion: it hangs in a cluster where every member's grip keeps the whole company together — community as a physical act it performs nightly.

nodes.label: Jay
nodes.lore_note: A verbal improviser with no audience filter: it broadcasts at hermits and highwaymen alike, picks up real speech when forced into solitude, and treats escape as a chance to say everything louder.

nodes.label: Nightingale
nodes.lore_note: A devoted night-worker: sleepless over its eggs, it turns duty into music and holds the vigil until the dawn its own song proclaims — service performed sweetly and without witness.

nodes.label: Goose
nodes.lore_note: A community watchman with the best nose in the book: it scents strangers before anyone sees them and raises the whole village with its warning voice, keeping the night watches by crying them out.

nodes.label: Heron
nodes.lore_note: A high-minded avoider: it senses disorder coming, rises above it entirely, and keeps its home in the tall quiet while taking its living from the waters below.

nodes.label: Partridge
nodes.lore_note: An inventive trickster working every angle: it steals eggs, fortifies the nursery in thorns, marks its secrets in dust, and when men come, improvises a crippled-bird performance on the spot to walk them away.

nodes.label: Halcyon
nodes.lore_note: A quiet sign-bearer: it nests in the worst of the year and brings fourteen days of peace with it — meaning carried by presence, not by noise or force.

nodes.label: Coot
nodes.lore_note: It stays, it feeds, it fosters: a devoted homebody whose one recorded act of greatness is quietly raising the child a king rejected.

nodes.label: Phoenix
nodes.lore_note: Utterly solitary and self-sufficient, it turns its own death into a private sacrament of renewal — feeling and meaning, no audience, no flock.

nodes.label: Caladrius
nodes.lore_note: A healer at the bedside: it faces the curable, takes their illness into its own body, and carries it away — devoted, personal, and entirely oriented to the patient's outcome.

nodes.label: Quail
nodes.lore_note: A flock organised around its mother-leader, migrating together on a fixed calendar and caring most about getting everyone across — guidance and group survival before everything.

nodes.label: Crow
nodes.lore_note: Long-lived, vocal and devoted: it escorts its young through the sky for seasons and cries the weather to anyone listening — expressive energy poured into family and signalling.

nodes.label: Swan
nodes.lore_note: A private artist with a public image: white, proud and musical on the surface, dark underneath — and most itself in its final, sweetest song.

nodes.label: Duck
nodes.lore_note: Uncomplicated and always in motion on the water, defined by doing rather than display — and, in the German kind, by a healthy appetite.

nodes.label: Peacock
nodes.lore_note: A born performer: it sets its feathers out in order for an audience, drinks in praise, and shows off — the account's whole psychology of the bird is theatrical.

nodes.label: Eagle
nodes.lore_note: A solitary sovereign judge: it tests its own children against the sun, keeps only what meets the standard, and renews itself by protocol rather than by hope.

nodes.label: Bee (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: The colony is the self and service is the joy: bees elect a merciful king, share every task and crumb, and hold their community's laws so dear they execute them on themselves.

nodes.label: Dragon (bestiary draco)
nodes.lore_note: A solitary ambush strategist: it learns the elephant's roads, waits without poison or haste, and kills by a single perfect constriction — power organised entirely around one plan.

nodes.label: Basilisk
nodes.lore_note: A remote, self-sufficient sovereign that kills by gaze and reputation and engages with nothing directly — except in flight from the one creature made to end it.

nodes.label: Viper
nodes.lore_note: Ruled by appetite and occasion: it mates across species by the shore, bites in ecstasy, and performs one extravagant courtesy — spitting out its venom for love — with its whole heart in the present act.

nodes.label: Asp
nodes.lore_note: Self-contained and un-summonable: it stops its own ears against every charmer, keeps to its cave, and lets its specialised chemistry do the talking only when bitten into action.

nodes.label: Scitalis
nodes.lore_note: A living artwork with a predator's patience: it does not perform or pursue — it simply shows its patterned back and lets the world's attention do the hunting.

nodes.label: Amphisbaena
nodes.lore_note: All action, both ways at once: it rolls toward either head without turning, comes out first into the cold, and meets the world lit-eyed and ready.

nodes.label: Hydrus
nodes.lore_note: A lone practical infiltrator: it studies the sleeping crocodile, coats itself in mud like a tool prepared for one job, and does its killing from the inside out.

nodes.label: Boa (bestiary boas)
nodes.lore_note: Patient and unshowy, it shadows the herd and feeds at the udder until the animal dies — a practical killer working the one moment its prey cannot run.

nodes.label: Jaculus
nodes.lore_note: Pure committed action: climb, wait, and the instant prey passes, spend its whole body in one throw — no second thoughts at javelin speed.

nodes.label: Siren (serpent kind)
nodes.lore_note: All velocity and nerve: a white flash faster than cavalry that can simply take wing instead — sensation, including the victim's last one, always arrives too late.

nodes.label: Seps
nodes.lore_note: Minimal and final: no display, no pursuit recorded — one bite and chemistry does everything, down to the bones.

nodes.label: Dipsas
nodes.lore_note: Invisible, unhurried and accidental: it does not ambush or display — it is simply underfoot, and its one reflex outruns the victim's senses entirely.

nodes.label: Lizard (general kind)
nodes.lore_note: A generalist frame — armed, low-slung, adaptable — whose distinctiveness the account immediately delegates to its stranger kinds.

nodes.label: Salamander (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Completely unbothered: it walks into flames that annihilate everything else, poisons an orchard by climbing one tree, and never hurries, chases or displays.

nodes.label: Saura
nodes.lore_note: Quiet and inward, it answers its own decay with a private ritual — a crack in a wall, a face turned east, patience for the light.

nodes.label: Newt (stellio)
nodes.lore_note: Compact and self-contained, wearing its stars without display; its hostility to scorpions is total and entirely passive — it only has to be seen.

nodes.label: Snake (general nature)
nodes.lore_note: The subtle experimenter of Genesis: it studies its own ageing and engineers the cure — fasting, friction, a narrow crack — and manages even its venom as a tool to be set down and taken up.

nodes.label: Worm (general kind)
nodes.lore_note: Undemanding and mechanical: it appears where flesh, wood or cloth decays, and gets wherever it is going by the simplest possible engineering.

nodes.label: Spider (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: A solitary engineer working to a plan it carries in its body: silk out, structure up, losses absorbed, rebuild begun — methodical, patient and entirely self-reliant.

nodes.label: Millipede (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: Quiet and defensive, it asks only to be left alone — and when it cannot be, it becomes a ball and waits the danger out.

nodes.label: Leech (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: An opportunist living entirely in the moment of the meal: seize the drinking throat, drain, empty, drain again — appetite with no memory and no plan beyond the next swallow.

nodes.label: Scorpion (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: A self-contained weapon system: it keeps to itself, strikes in one practised arc when touched, and observes exactly one restraint — the palm goes unstung.

nodes.label: Silkworm (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: A devoted producer: it feeds quietly on leaves and pours its whole body into thread for others' use, keeping nothing — not even, in the end, itself.

nodes.label: Caterpillar (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: A patient specialist: folded into its food, unbothered by variety, it simply stays and eats — slowly, thoroughly, and to the end.

nodes.label: Woodworm (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: Methodical and hidden, it works away inside the timber grain by grain — steady, invisible industry with a thoroughly predictable result.

nodes.label: Clothes Moth (bestiary worm)
nodes.lore_note: Dogged and single-minded, it burrows into one fabric and works at it without pause or variety until the work — and the garment — is done.

nodes.label: Fish (general nature)
nodes.lore_note: The account's fish is defined by devotion: the live-bearing mother turns her own body into a fortress for her young, again and again, without limit — care as the sea's first law, whatever the second law of eating may say.

nodes.label: Whale (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A patient deceiver working a single perfect scheme: perfume the water, hold position, and close the trap at exactly the moment it fills — long stillness in service of one calculated snap.

nodes.label: Flying-fish (bestiary sea monster)
nodes.lore_note: A spectacular beginner: it throws itself into the race beside the ship at full wing, lives entirely in the burst — and when the burst ends, folds up and drifts home.

nodes.label: Dolphin (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A sociable, music-drawn sprinter: it seeks out human voices, gathers its school for a song, and turns even a coming storm into a leaping game beside the ships.

nodes.label: Sea-pig
nodes.lore_note: Practical and snout-first, it works the seabed the way its namesake works a field — head down, digging dinner out of the ground it swims over.

nodes.label: Swordfish (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Bold and direct, it meets the largest thing in its world — a ship — head-on, with the weapon it was born wearing.

nodes.label: Sawfish (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A quiet tradesman of destruction, working underneath the hull with the tool on its head — patient, unseen, and finished before anyone knows it started.

nodes.label: Sea-scorpion (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Still, spiny and reactive: it asks only not to be handled, and answers handling the way its land namesake answers everything.

nodes.label: Crocodile (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A self-sufficient armoured landlord: it keeps its hours (water by night, bank by day), shares the guard duty fairly, and fears nothing it can see coming.

nodes.label: Pike (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A lone calculating predator: ravenous in the hunt, and in the trap — where panicking fish dash themselves — it makes its own weather out of sand and walks out through it.

nodes.label: Mullet (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Delicate and mild, it makes no demands and starts no fights; its whole reputation is the quiet change it works in those who take it in.

nodes.label: Mugil (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Quick-eyed and quicker-finned, it sizes up the set net in an instant and answers with the boldest move available: straight over it, in plain sight.

nodes.label: Scarus (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Clever in the service of others: it solves its own escape by thinking in reverse — then spends the solution immediately on a struggling fellow, tail in teeth, hauling it free.

nodes.label: Remora (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Steadfast to the point of legend: it chooses its hull, attaches, and simply does not let go — duty as suction, outlasting wind and storm alike.

nodes.label: Eel (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Self-reliant and untouchable, it slips every grip by the grip's own force and keeps its own counsel in the mud it was born from.

nodes.label: Lamprey (Murena)
nodes.lore_note: A feeling-led creature of the water's edge: it follows one call with its whole heart, coils into its circles, and asks nothing of the world but the shore where the hissing comes from.

nodes.label: Polypus (bestiary octopus)
nodes.lore_note: A solitary experimenter working the fisherman's own tackle against him: it takes the hook in its arms, studies it by touch, and calmly eats the bait off it.

nodes.label: Torpedo (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A remote, untouchable power that never engages directly: it lets the fisherman's own spear deliver the effect, and stands off while strength and speed drain out of its enemies.

nodes.label: Crab (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A quiet engineer of other creatures' weaknesses: it studies the oyster's habits, waits for the exact unguarded moment, and solves a strength problem with a pebble and perfect timing.

nodes.label: Sea-urchin (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A quiet prophet that acts on what it knows without display: it reads the sky infallibly, takes up its pebble, and anchors itself — certainty expressed as preparation, not proclamation.

nodes.label: Pearl Oyster (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A private, nocturnal treasure-maker: it keeps the sea's hours in reverse, meets the dew alone on the night shore, and turns the encounter inward into something precious and hidden.

nodes.label: Murex (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Quiet and rough-shelled, keeping its one glory enclosed — it does not display its purple; the colour exists only when the creature is wounded for it.

nodes.label: Oyster (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A homebody devoted to its own walls: it asks for safety, a little sun, a breath of air — and opens its whole house for them, trusting the calm it feels.

nodes.label: Tortoise (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: Steady, sheltered and unhurried, it carries its home into every element — land, sea, mud and river — and lets the world happen outside the vault.

nodes.label: Frog (bestiary account)
nodes.lore_note: A born chorister: it fills its marsh with constant sociable noise, calls out in its peculiar voice to all its neighbours, and treats breeding season as a festival of sound.

nodes.label: Aboleth
nodes.lore_note: Lawful evil aberration, INT 18/WIS 15/CHA 18: an alien mind whose categories do not map onto mortal ones; the pattern — extraverted force of presence, abstract, scheme-first thinking, logic over feeling, and a structured, decided style — reads as ENTJ.
