nodes.label: Zeus
nodes.address: Olympus > the throne of Zeus, lord of the sky
nodes.lore_note: Canonical Zeus rules by decree, enforces oaths and guest-right, presides over councils of gods and settles disputes by final judgement — leadership organised outward, on a cosmic scale.

nodes.label: Hera
nodes.address: Olympus > the throne beside Zeus; Argos as her favoured city
nodes.lore_note: Canonical Hera upholds marriage as an institution, defends her rank by rule and precedent, and pursues breaches methodically over years — order, hierarchy and enforcement over improvisation.

nodes.label: Poseidon
nodes.address: The sea > the palace beneath the waves; Olympus by council right
nodes.lore_note: Canonical Poseidon acts in surges — he raises storms, shakes earth and pursues Odysseus's offence in person and at once rather than by Zeus-like decree; a physical, present-tense ruler of his element.

nodes.label: Hades
nodes.address: The underworld > the house of Hades, below the earth
nodes.lore_note: Canonical Hades keeps his realm by rule and register, seldom leaves it, seldom quarrels, and settles even Persephone's case by negotiated terms — the dutiful custodian, not the raging tyrant of later retellings.

nodes.label: Athena
nodes.address: Olympus and Athens > the Acropolis, her chosen city
nodes.lore_note: Athena's canon is strategy, craft and counsel — she wins Athens with the useful olive over Poseidon's showy salt spring, coaches Odysseus's schemes, and fights wars by design, explicitly not Ares's bloodlust; a master-planner read from her deeds.

nodes.label: Apollo
nodes.address: Delphi and Delos > the oracle at the navel of the world; Olympus by right
nodes.lore_note: Apollo's canon is teaching-through-oracle, music, healing and radiant leadership of the Muses' company — a charismatic pattern-reader whose judgements (Cassandra, Marsyas, Niobe's children) are delivered as pronouncements, not brawls.

nodes.label: Artemis
nodes.address: The wild mountains > Arcadia and Ephesus; Olympus reluctantly
nodes.lore_note: Artemis's canon is solitary mastery of the wild — she hunts, tracks and answers transgression by direct action in the field, keeps chosen company only, and shuns Olympus's courts and marriage alike.

nodes.label: Ares
nodes.address: Thrace and the battlefield > wherever war is; Olympus under protest
nodes.lore_note: Ares's canon is action without counsel — he plunges into the Iliad's fighting in person, changes sides by appetite, and when wounded retreats bellowing rather than adapting; sensation and impact first, always.

nodes.label: Aphrodite
nodes.address: Paphos and Cythera > the foam-born's seats; Olympus by marriage and power
nodes.lore_note: Aphrodite's canon is present-tense, relational and sensory — she acts through charm, favour and desire in the moment (Paris's bower, the cestus loan, rescuing Paris from the duel), not through plans or institutions.

nodes.label: Hephaestus
nodes.address: Lemnos and the forge under Etna > Olympus by indispensable craft
nodes.lore_note: Hephaestus's canon is hands-on problem-solving — insulted or betrayed, he builds the response (the invisible net, the golden throne-trap for Hera in the tale), works alone at his forge, and judges by what functions.

nodes.label: Hermes
nodes.address: The roads between worlds > every threshold, herm and highway; Cyllene his birth-mountain
nodes.lore_note: Hermes's canon is improvisation in transit — day-old, he invents the lyre, steals and re-brands Apollo's cattle, talks his way out of judgement, and ever after solves errands by wit and charm mid-journey; ideas and people are his element.

nodes.label: Dionysus
nodes.address: The wandering thiasos > Thebes, Naxos and every vineyard; Olympus as the youngest seat
nodes.lore_note: Dionysus's canon is ecstatic communion — he wins cities not by decree or battle but by a joy-cult that sweeps up women, slaves and kings' houses alike (the Bacchae's Thebes); feeling, festival and the crowd are his instruments.

nodes.label: Demeter
nodes.address: Eleusis and the grain-lands > the Rarian plain; Olympus as harvest's seat
nodes.lore_note: Demeter's canon is devoted provision turned to devoted grief — she feeds the world, searches it torch-in-hand for her daughter, and negotiates from love rather than ambition; care administered at planetary scale.

nodes.label: Persephone
nodes.address: Between worlds > the asphodel meadows below and the spring fields above, by the year's terms
nodes.lore_note: Persephone's canon turns on felt experience carried between worlds — the flower-meadow, the pomegranate, the yearly return are sensory and relational facts in the Hymn, and as queen she acts from a sufferer's knowledge of both realms.

nodes.label: Heracles
nodes.address: The heroic road > Thebes, Tiryns and the sites of the Labours; Olympus after death
nodes.lore_note: Heracles' canon is feat-first problem-solving under orders — he wrestles, lifts and outlasts the Labours, improvises tools mid-feat (Iolaus's torch at the Hydra), and expresses remorse through service, not reflection; action is his language.

nodes.label: Medusa
nodes.address: Beyond Ocean, at the edge of Night > the Gorgons' shore
nodes.lore_note: Medusa's canon is solitary, reactive mastery of one perfect mechanism — she holds her ground, lets heroes come to her, and the gaze does the rest; no speeches, no schemes, in the early sources almost no words at all.

nodes.label: The Minotaur
nodes.address: Crete > Knossos, the heart of the Labyrinth
nodes.lore_note: The Minotaur's canon is pure embodied appetite — it charges, feeds and roams its maze by sense and habit; no source gives it speech, tools or society, so the read is the most physical type available.

nodes.label: Cerberus
nodes.address: The gates of Hades > the threshold of the underworld
nodes.lore_note: Cerberus's canon is duty executed by rule — he greets the entering dead, destroys the leaving, and answers to Hades alone; the most literal rule-follower in the Greek monster register.

nodes.label: The Lernaean Hydra
nodes.address: The swamp of Lerna > the spring Amymone, its lair
nodes.lore_note: The Hydra's canon is physical problem-embodiment — no speech, no negotiation; it adapts to damage mechanically and immediately, the most purely reactive system among the Labours' monsters.

nodes.label: Pegasus
nodes.address: The springs of Corinth and Mount Helicon > Olympus, in the end
nodes.lore_note: Pegasus's canon is sensory, free and experience-led — born marvellous, caught only in sleep by a goddess's device, a partner in one great feat, and gone to the gods when the rider's ambition overreached; feeling and freedom over any system.

nodes.label: The Chimera
nodes.address: Lycia > Mount Chimaera, its burning haunt
nodes.lore_note: The Chimera's canon is embodied tri-form predation — it burns, charges and strikes as three animals at once; no source grants it speech, craft or plan.

nodes.label: The Sphinx (Greek)
nodes.address: The road to Thebes > the rock of Phicium, outside the city
nodes.lore_note: The Greek Sphinx's canon is a single elegant system — she poses the Muses' riddle, grades answers absolutely, and ceases when the system is solved; a pattern-mind with one perfect pattern, not a roving predator.

nodes.label: Typhon
nodes.address: Sicily > beneath Mount Etna, his prison; born of Earth and Tartarus
nodes.lore_note: Typhon's canon is direct cosmic confrontation — he challenges Zeus hand-to-hand at once, improvises theft of the god's sinews and weapon, and stakes everything on one overwhelming assault; action at maximum scale, no administration anywhere in it.

nodes.label: Echidna
nodes.address: A hollow cave beneath the earth > at the margins of the Greek world
nodes.lore_note: Echidna's canon is embodied and territorial — she keeps her cave, eats raw flesh, and shapes the world by bearing its monsters, never by speech, journey or scheme in the early sources.

nodes.label: Scylla
nodes.address: The strait of Scylla and Charybdis > her cliff cave, at ship-mast height
nodes.lore_note: Scylla's canon is one perfected physical routine — she waits, measures the passing hull, and strikes sixfold; no dialogue, no pursuit, no second behaviour in the Odyssey's account.

nodes.label: Charybdis
nodes.address: The strait, opposite Scylla > beneath the fig tree on the low rock
nodes.lore_note: Charybdis's canon is a single repeated physical act on a fixed cycle — swallow and spout, thrice daily, without variation, speech or response; the read given is the most mechanical available and is flagged as a formality for a being with no attested mind.

nodes.label: Argus Panoptes
nodes.address: Argos > the pasture where Io was tethered
nodes.lore_note: Argus's canon is dutiful single-task vigilance — posted by Hera, he watches Io without lapse, negotiation or curiosity beyond the charge, until a god's storytelling turns duty off eye by eye.

nodes.label: Talos
nodes.address: Crete > the whole coastline, three circuits a day
nodes.lore_note: Talos's canon is flawless routine execution — the same patrol, the same response, without fatigue, doubt or variation, ended only when his single design flaw is found; duty as mechanism, literally.

nodes.label: Ra
nodes.address: Heliopolis and the whole sky > the bark's circuit, day and night
nodes.lore_note: Ra's canon in Budge's texts is executive creation — he orders the world by utterance, commands the bark's crew of gods, and rules as the sun's king whose authority even Isis must obtain by negotiation, not seizure.

nodes.label: Osiris
nodes.address: The Duat > the hall of Osiris; in life, the first throne of Egypt
nodes.lore_note: Osiris's canon is the visionary pattern held for others — teacher of civilisation, suffering archetype, and still judge whose own story becomes the template of salvation in Budge's texts; quiet conviction, not administration or war.

nodes.label: Isis
nodes.address: The Delta marshes and every temple of the mourning > Philae in the later cult; the search-road of Egypt
nodes.lore_note: Isis's canon is devoted mastery in action — she quests, negotiates, heals and teaches spells while carrying the pantheon's heaviest grief, leading every effort she joins by competence and care together.

nodes.label: Set
nodes.address: The red desert and the storm > the prow of Ra's bark by night; Ombos his cult seat
nodes.lore_note: Set's canon is forceful improvisation against order — the coffin stratagem, the dismemberment, the Contendings' brawls and lawsuits; he acts, disrupts and contests in person, and even his cosmic duty (spearing Apep) is done by main strength at the prow.

nodes.label: Horus
nodes.address: The Delta marshes, then the throne > the sky over all Egypt; Edfu his great cult seat
nodes.lore_note: Horus's canon is a claim prosecuted to the end — he fights Set, litigates before the Ennead, endures the court's delays, and takes his father's throne as duty fulfilled; order restored by the rightful heir is his whole story-shape.

nodes.label: Anubis
nodes.address: The necropolis at the desert's edge > the embalming tent and the hall of weighing
nodes.lore_note: Anubis's canon is meticulous service — he embalms Osiris by the full rite, guards the necropolis without lapse, and tends the balance exactly; duty, craft and discretion define every appearance Budge's texts give him.

nodes.label: Bastet
nodes.address: Bubastis in the Delta > every Egyptian home with a cat
nodes.lore_note: Bastet's canon in Herodotus and Budge is communal and nurturing — her festival gathers Egypt in joy, her care covers home, children and childbirth, and her protection is exercised inside the household she keeps.

nodes.label: Sekhmet
nodes.address: Memphis and the battlefield > wherever the Eye is sent; the red fields of the legend
nodes.lore_note: Sekhmet's canon is unleashed physical action — sent to destroy mankind, she slaughters beyond her orders' intent and is stopped only by trickery and drunken satiety, never by command or counter-argument.

nodes.label: Thoth
nodes.address: Hermopolis and the moon > the hall of weighing, stylus in hand; every scribe's desk in Egypt
nodes.lore_note: Thoth's canon is knowledge systematised and shared on request — he invents writing, keeps the reckoning of years, records the weighing, heals the eye, and wins Nut her five days by out-playing the moon; curiosity and exact system over every other drive.

nodes.label: Ammit
nodes.address: The hall of Osiris > beside the balance, in the Duat
nodes.lore_note: Ammit's canonical 'behaviour' is a single procedural act — wait by the scales, receive the condemned heart, devour it; the type assigned is a formality for a being with no attested mind beyond function, and is recorded as such.

nodes.label: Apep
nodes.address: The Duat's dark reaches and the dawn waters > wherever the bark must pass
nodes.lore_note: Apep's canon is one repeated physical assault — ambush the bark, attempt the swallow, be speared and bound, return entire; the read is a formality over a being whose texts grant appetite and recurrence, not reflection.

nodes.label: Sobek
nodes.address: The Nile and the Faiyum > Crocodilopolis and Kom Ombo; every crossing of his waters
nodes.lore_note: Sobek's canon is the crocodile's method at divine scale — long territorial stillness, explosive seizure, and a river kept by presence; the Middle Kingdom hymns praise exactly this contained, watchful ferocity as kingship's mirror.

nodes.label: The Great Sphinx of Giza
nodes.address: Giza plateau > east-facing, before the pyramids, in the necropolis it guards
nodes.lore_note: The Giza Sphinx's record is steadfast guardianship — it watches, endures, and in its one speaking appearance (the Dream Stela) makes and keeps a covenant bargain; duty and patience across millennia are the whole behavioural file.

nodes.label: Odin
nodes.lore_note: A solitary strategist who sacrifices an eye, hangs in torment for runes, and plans an age ahead for a battle he knows he will lose — vision and system over comfort or company.

nodes.label: Thor
nodes.lore_note: A hearty, present-tense defender who answers a giant problem by walking straight at it with a hammer, then feasts with friends — action and loyalty over scheming.

nodes.label: Loki
nodes.address: Asgard (nominal) > the cave of binding, at the world's edge
nodes.lore_note: Every crisis becomes an invention, a disguise or a wager: he brainstorms with his own body, talks his way out, and only stops improvising when bound in a cave.

nodes.label: Freyja
nodes.lore_note: She leads by presence and feeling openly displayed — weeping, searching, desiring, and choosing warriors — a ruler whose emotions are policy, not weakness.

nodes.label: Baldr
nodes.lore_note: A gentle idealist known for light, mercy and true dreams rather than deeds of force — the tales praise his inner quality and mourn it, which is the whole point of him.

nodes.label: Jörmungandr
nodes.address: The world-ocean > the rim of Midgard
nodes.lore_note: It waits in the deep for ages, reacts with total physical force when hooked, and saves its one great act for Ragnarök — solitary, embodied, patient.

nodes.label: Hel
nodes.lore_note: She runs her realm by fixed rule, receives a god's embassy without flinching, and answers grief with a written condition — duty and literalism over feeling.

nodes.label: Huginn
nodes.lore_note: A far-ranging scout that tests the whole world daily and reports back — curiosity in service, the real raven's playfulness tasked as reconnaissance.

nodes.label: Muninn
nodes.lore_note: It keeps what the pair has seen across years of flights — the quiet, retentive partner whose work is holding, not chasing.

nodes.label: Sleipnir
nodes.address: Asgard > Odin's stables; roads across the Nine Realms
nodes.lore_note: It expresses itself entirely in motion — sure-footed, responsive, unafraid of the road to the dead — a doer whose character is the journey completed.

nodes.label: Brynhildr
nodes.address: The fire-ringed hall on Hindarfjall > the Burgundian court > Hel's road
nodes.lore_note: She acts from an absolute inner code — defying Odin for a just outcome, loving once and totally, and choosing the pyre rather than a compromised life.

nodes.label: Ratatoskr
nodes.address: Yggdrasil > the trunk, crown to roots
nodes.lore_note: It lives for the run and the reaction — darting the full height of the world daily, delivering words that bite, and thriving on the friction it carries.

nodes.label: Níðhöggr
nodes.address: Under Yggdrasil > Nastrond, the shore of corpses
nodes.lore_note: It does one dark duty forever without speech, negotiation or deviation — gnaw, suck the condemned, fly at the end — routine as doom.

nodes.label: Amaterasu
nodes.address: Takamagahara > the Heavenly Rock Cave and the high plain
nodes.lore_note: She governs a court, feels outrage deeply, withdraws — and is won back not by force but by joy and the sight of her own radiance reflected, a ruler led by meaning.

nodes.label: Susanoo
nodes.address: Takamagahara (exiled) > Izumo, the land of his settlement
nodes.lore_note: He breaks heaven's rules in person, weeps, rages, then solves an eight-headed problem with barrels and timing — all action, all heart, minimal committee.

nodes.label: Tsukuyomi
nodes.address: The night realm > the moon's court
nodes.lore_note: He attends by proxy, judges by fixed standards of purity, acts once and finally, and keeps his distance ever after — procedure and principle over warmth.

nodes.label: Ryūjin
nodes.lore_note: He runs an undersea court with messengers, treasures and standing prohibitions, and receives guests like a king who expects eternity to behave itself.

nodes.label: Inari
nodes.address: Fushimi Inari > the mountain of a thousand torii
nodes.lore_note: She provides, connects and blesses through a vast messenger network — a patron whose power is generosity organised at national scale.

nodes.label: Sōjōbō
nodes.address: Mount Kurama > the tengu king's court
nodes.lore_note: He withdraws to a mountain court, evaluates one boy, and invests years of secret instruction in a single strategic bet on the future — patience and judgement over display.

nodes.label: Shuten-dōji
nodes.lore_note: He takes, feasts and boasts in the present tense, surrounded by his court — sensation and dominance now, with no plan for the yamabushi at the door.

nodes.label: Yuki-onna
nodes.address: The snowy mountains and passes of the north
nodes.lore_note: She chooses mercy once, builds a quiet family life in disguise, and leaves without violence when the vow breaks — feeling governed entirely by one deep condition.

nodes.label: Kappa
nodes.address: Rivers, ponds and irrigation pools across Japan
nodes.lore_note: It challenges strangers to sumo, steals, pranks and bows itself helpless — a physical, present-tense joker whose rules are as strong as its arms.

nodes.label: Bake-danuki
nodes.address: Hills, temple yards and country roads of Japan
nodes.lore_note: It turns into a kettle to repay a kindness, throws ghost parties for travellers, and pays with leaves — invention and sociability in service of the next good evening.

nodes.label: Bakeneko
nodes.address: Old houses and castle towns of Japan
nodes.lore_note: It watches for years, learns the household entire, and acts at last from its own hidden agenda — solitary, patient, and theatrical only when it chooses to be seen dancing.

nodes.label: The Morrígan
nodes.address: Battlefields of Ireland > the ford of the Táin
nodes.lore_note: She speaks in prophecy, tests the hero with an offer, and answers refusal with a long, symbolic campaign before healing the wounds she made — meaning and doom over impulse.

nodes.label: Cú Chulainn
nodes.address: Ulster > the fords of the Táin and Muirthemne
nodes.lore_note: He acts, leaps and fights first — boyhood deeds at full sprint — yet honours ritual, friendship and word even when they kill him: sensation ruled by honour.

nodes.label: Lugh
nodes.address: Tara > the battlefield of Mag Tuired
nodes.lore_note: He arrives with a plan, proves competence in every category, organises a divine war effort, and executes the prophesied shot — leadership as demonstrated systems mastery.

nodes.label: Brigid
nodes.address: Kildare > the fire-house; all Ireland at Imbolc
nodes.lore_note: She creates, heals and teaches, tends a communal flame, and turns even her son's death into the invention of communal lament — feeling organised into culture.

nodes.label: The Banshee
nodes.address: The sídhe mounds and fords of Ireland > the ancestral houses she serves
nodes.lore_note: She keeps to one family's story across centuries, grieves in advance, and asks nothing but to be heard and respected — quiet, devoted, and misunderstood as horror.

nodes.label: The Púca
nodes.address: Lonely roads, bogs and harvest fields of Ireland
nodes.lore_note: It improvises a shape, a ride and a moral for each night's wanderer — invention and mischief first, with counsel nobody asked for delivered at a gallop.

nodes.label: The Selkie
nodes.address: The northern shores > Orkney, Shetland and the Irish coast
nodes.lore_note: She lives feelingly in both worlds — a kind wife and mother on land, a seal in her soul — and follows the deepest pull the instant choice is restored to her.

nodes.label: Tiamat
nodes.address: The salt sea before heaven and earth
nodes.lore_note: She endures noise for her children's sake, is driven to war by loss and insult, and creates even in defeat — feeling and generation over strategy, against Marduk's calculated bargain.

nodes.label: Marduk
nodes.address: Babylon > Esagila, his temple; the ordered cosmos
nodes.lore_note: He negotiates supreme authority in assembly, engineers a monster's defeat with nets and winds, then administers a universe — command through system-building at every step.

nodes.label: Ishtar / Inanna
nodes.address: Uruk and the heavens (Venus) > the seven gates of the underworld
nodes.lore_note: She proposes, feasts, descends and rages in person — sensation and sovereignty fused — yet her descent shows a strategist willing to be unmade to reach the underworld's throne room.

nodes.label: The Lamassu
nodes.address: Assyrian palace gateways > Nineveh, Khorsabad, Nimrud
nodes.lore_note: It takes its post, keeps its post, and judges all comers by fixed standards for centuries — duty, vigilance and deterrence without ambition or drift.

nodes.label: Ao Guang
nodes.address: The East Sea > the crystal palace
nodes.lore_note: He rules by court, catalogue and complaint — order, hierarchy and precedent — and escalates through proper channels even in a blood feud.

nodes.label: Sun Wukong
nodes.address: The Mountain of Flowers and Fruit > the road west
nodes.lore_note: He argues with heaven, rewrites death's book, steals immortality three ways, and still shows up for the escort job — invention, defiance and loyalty in one restless package.

nodes.label: The Qilin
nodes.address: Where sages are born > the well-governed age
nodes.lore_note: It perceives the moral weather, appears exactly where meaning is densest, harms nothing, and withdraws — quiet significance over any display.

nodes.label: The Fenghuang
nodes.address: The wutong trees > the well-ruled realm
nodes.lore_note: It keeps to pure food, high trees and good ages, and certifies harmony simply by consenting to be seen — standards quietly and absolutely held.

nodes.label: Indra
nodes.address: Svarga > Amaravati, his capital; the blocked rivers of the Vritra myth
nodes.lore_note: In the hymns he drinks, boasts and smashes the serpent in person; in the epics he schemes from the throne — action decaying into incumbency is his documented character arc.

nodes.label: Ganesha
nodes.address: Every threshold in the Hindu world > first seat at every rite
nodes.lore_note: He guards his mother's door absolutely, wins a world-race by redefining the course around love, and writes down the greatest epic without pause — devotion and cleverness in warm harness.

nodes.label: Garuda
nodes.address: The sky over the worlds > Vishnu's banner
nodes.lore_note: He acts at sky-speed: hatches blazing, bargains once, steals heaven's treasure through its defences, and honours the deal to the drop — physical, loyal, exact.

nodes.label: Shesha
nodes.address: The cosmic ocean > beneath and around the sleeping Vishnu
nodes.lore_note: He renounces his kin's cruelty for austerity, accepts an eternal support role as a blessing, and serves across incarnations as a devoted brother — care as cosmic function.

nodes.label: Michael the Archangel
nodes.address: Daniel's visions; the war in heaven (Revelation 12); guardian's post over the Church
nodes.lore_note: The field-marshal of the tradition's own telling: he arrays a host, fights the decisive war of Revelation, and defends a people as a long campaign — strategy, command and loyalty to the charge above all.

nodes.label: Raphael the Archangel
nodes.address: The road to Media in Tobit; among the seven who stand before the glory of God
nodes.lore_note: The mentor at walking pace: he organises a whole family's healing around one journey, teaches Tobias by doing, and measures success in other people's restored lives — warmth with a complete therapeutic plan.

nodes.label: Uriel
nodes.address: The courses of the luminaries; the night colloquies of 2 Esdras
nodes.lore_note: The austere systematiser: he holds the whole timetable of heaven, answers anguish with structure, and teaches by forcing the student to reckon with scale — insight without sentimentality.

nodes.label: Metatron
nodes.domain: Jewish Mystical Tradition — the Heavenly Court
nodes.address: The throne of the Presence; the seventh palace of the Heikhalot ascent
nodes.lore_note: The supreme registrar: a mind that turned a human life into heaven's filing system, works at the scale of all deeds and all secrets, and submits his own near-divinity to correction — system first, self last.

nodes.label: Azrael
nodes.address: Every deathbed; in the Islamic lists, among the four great angels
nodes.lore_note: The perfect functionary of the traditions' own telling: an appointment kept everywhere and always, without cruelty, favour or error — duty as the whole personality.

nodes.label: Sandalphon
nodes.domain: Jewish Tradition — the Chariot and the Court
nodes.address: Behind the Merkabah; at the foot of the Throne, where the prayers arrive
nodes.lore_note: The quiet giant of the foot of the throne: immensely strong in presence yet wholly given to service — gathering small human voices and presenting them as crowns, care performed at cosmic scale.

nodes.label: Cassiel
nodes.address: The sphere of Saturn; the Saturday station of the planetary week
nodes.lore_note: The solitary contemplative of the lists: no deeds, no speeches, no court — only watching, waiting and the mathematics of the slowest sphere; a thinker defined by distance.

nodes.label: Zadkiel
nodes.address: The sphere of Chesed in the lists; the altar on Moriah, at the last instant
nodes.lore_note: The counsellor of the knife's edge: quietly certain about right, quicker to forgive than to condemn, and defined by one merciful interruption that echoes through the whole tradition.

nodes.label: The Seraphim
nodes.address: Above the Throne, in the temple of Isaiah's vision; first choir of the nine
nodes.lore_note: A communal read for a communal being: the seraphim exist in antiphon — feeling-led, other-directed, organised entirely around a shared centre and the voices answering theirs.

nodes.label: The Cherubim
nodes.address: The east of Eden; the mercy seat; beneath the Throne in Ezekiel's chariot
nodes.lore_note: The wardens of the threshold: exact, vigilant, duty-defined — they hold a gate for millennia without curiosity about what lies past their orders, and their knowledge serves custody, not display.

nodes.label: Samyaza
nodes.domain: Book of Enoch Tradition — the Watchers
nodes.address: Mount Hermon, the oath-site; then the valleys of the earth, bound for seventy generations
nodes.lore_note: The ringleader as organiser: he foresees defection, designs the oath that prevents it, and leads a host across a line none would cross alone — command charisma in service of a catastrophic decision.

nodes.label: Azazel
nodes.domain: Book of Enoch Tradition / the Wilderness of the Rite
nodes.address: The desert of Dudael, bound; and the wilderness road of the Yom Kippur goat
nodes.lore_note: The hands-on corrupter: a maker and showman whose gifts are real skills, immediately usable, taught with flair — action, appetite and craft over any system or creed.

nodes.label: Lucifer
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: Isaiah's taunt-song; the court of the fallen host
nodes.lore_note: The fallen first minister: a commanding, system-scale intellect whose whole tragedy the tradition states in one word — pride; he does not rage blindly, he *reigns* in refusal, organising a rival court rather than dissolving into chaos.

nodes.label: Satan
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: The divine council of Job; the wilderness; the dragon's seat in Revelation
nodes.lore_note: The eternal cross-examiner: he argues, offers, reframes and tests — a debater with subpoena power whose favourite experiment is the controlled destruction of a good man's reasons.

nodes.label: Beelzebub
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: Ekron's shrine; the prince's seat in the Gospel controversy's picture of hell
nodes.lore_note: The prince as state-builder: he runs a kingdom coherent enough that its internal division is a theological argument — command, registry and rival sovereignty define him across every stratum.

nodes.label: Leviathan
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: The sea of Job 41; the deep of the primordial pair
nodes.lore_note: A deliberately thin read for a force of nature: solitary, physical, unbargainable, reacting to contact with total force and otherwise indifferent — the type is a label on a magnitude, and the record says so.

nodes.label: Behemoth
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: The river-meadow of Job 40; the dry land of the primordial pair
nodes.lore_note: The gentlest read in the Adversary domain, honestly come by: a solitary, sensory, unhurried giant who harms nothing in his text and is exhibited as a wonder, not a warning.

nodes.label: Mammon
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: The counting-house implied by the saying; the princes' bench in the later schemes
nodes.lore_note: The administrator of appetite: orderly, tireless, respectable — Mammon's temptation arrives as good management, prudent provision and a well-kept book, which is exactly what the tradition finds frightening about him.

nodes.label: Belphegor
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: Mount Peor and Shittim (biblical stratum); the princes' bench in the schemes
nodes.lore_note: The inventive idler as system: curious, ingenious, allergic to exertion on principle — his schemes are elegant machines for making effort unnecessary, including the effort of resistance.

nodes.label: Lilith
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons — Jewish folklore layer
nodes.address: The shore of the Red Sea (Ben Sira); the night side of the nursery door
nodes.lore_note: The defiant solitary of the folklore: her legend's engine is a value — equality — held against paradise itself; private, night-going and unbargainable, feeling the insult across millennia.

nodes.label: Samael
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons — Jewish tradition layer
nodes.address: The left-hand side of the heavenly court; the patron's seat over Rome
nodes.lore_note: The system's own executioner-strategist: cold, procedural, empire-scale — his menace in the sources is administrative, a master of the long file and the final order, loyal to the throne whose severity he embodies.

nodes.label: Abaddon / Apollyon
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: The shaft of the abyss; the locust host's muster
nodes.lore_note: The warden who executes a limited warrant to the letter: dutiful, exact, and terrifying precisely because nothing in his one scene is excess — every torment is authorised, enumerated and bounded.

nodes.label: Mephistopheles
nodes.domain: The Adversary and the Named Great Demons
nodes.address: The Spessart crossroads; Faust's study, Wittenberg
nodes.lore_note: The witty negotiator of the legend: improvisational, ironic, delighted by argument, happiest at the moment a clever man signs — intellect as salesmanship, negation as charm.

nodes.label: The Golem of Prague
nodes.address: The Prague ghetto; the attic of the Old-New Synagogue
nodes.lore_note: The literal servant as type: dutiful, rule-bound, tireless, incapable of improvisation or deceit — the folklore's own portrait of a mind made of instructions and clay.

nodes.label: The Dybbuk
nodes.address: The wedding canopy of Ansky's telling; the possessed houses of the early-modern accounts
nodes.lore_note: The dead as the tales present them: feeling-led, vow-bound, incapable of letting go — the dybbuk possesses because its unfinished love or wrong outweighs death itself, and it confesses because being understood is the only rest on offer.

nodes.label: Iblis
nodes.address: The prostration scene of the Qur'an; the whisper's range, which is everywhere Adam's children are
nodes.lore_note: The fire-born debater: he argues his case to God's face, negotiates his reprieve, and spends eternity making arguments at whisper-volume — inventive, proud, rhetorical, and bound by a limit he himself recites.

nodes.label: Human
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Primates > Family Hominidae > Homo sapiens
nodes.lore_note: A restless, talkative idea-generaliser: it debates, invents, teaches and reframes everything as a story or a system, and gets bored by any settled routine.

nodes.label: Chimpanzee
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Primates > Family Hominidae > Pan troglodytes
nodes.lore_note: An inventive, status-playing improviser: it tools, tricks, performs for an audience and renegotiates every alliance — curiosity and politics in one restless package.

nodes.label: Bonobo
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Primates > Family Hominidae > Pan paniscus
nodes.lore_note: A warm, playful peace-maker: it meets tension with contact and sharing, follows feeling and relationship first, and keeps the whole group's mood as its home territory.

nodes.label: Mountain gorilla
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Primates > Family Hominidae > Gorilla beringei
nodes.lore_note: A quiet, dutiful protector: the silverback's whole style is steady care — decide the route, keep the family fed and together, meet threats himself — with novelty a distant second to duty.

nodes.label: Bornean orangutan
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Primates > Family Hominidae > Pongo pygmaeus
nodes.lore_note: A lone, patient engineer-thinker: it lives inside a vast private map of the forest, experiments quietly, plans seasons ahead, and treats company as an occasional resource, not a need.

nodes.label: African bush elephant
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Proboscidea > Family Elephantidae > Loxodonta africana
nodes.lore_note: The matriarch-teacher: it leads by remembered knowledge, keeps the whole extended family oriented and calm, and puts the group's welfare — especially the young and old — at the centre of every decision.

nodes.label: Bottlenose dolphin
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Cetacea > Family Delphinidae > Tursiops truncatus
nodes.lore_note: A playful, hyper-social improviser: it surfs, games, invents hunting tricks with its pod, and treats every encounter — fish, boat or stranger — as something to explore out loud.

nodes.label: Orca
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Cetacea > Family Delphinidae > Orcinus orca
nodes.lore_note: A commanding strategist hunting as a coordinated unit: every attack is a planned team operation, roles are assigned, traditions are enforced, and the matriarch's experience directs the whole pod.

nodes.label: Sperm whale
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Cetacea > Family Physeteridae > Physeter macrocephalus
nodes.lore_note: A deep, deliberate clan strategist: it lives by long patterns — clan codas, remembered ocean routes, hour-long dives executed to plan — private, systematic and almost impossible to hurry.

nodes.label: Blue whale
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Cetacea > Family Balaenopteridae > Balaenoptera musculus
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, gentle wanderer following an inner calendar: it crosses whole oceans alone to remembered feeding places, sings its low songs to no visible audience, and asks nothing of any group.

nodes.label: Domestic dog
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Canidae > Canis familiaris
nodes.lore_note: A devoted, people-reading provider: it watches its humans constantly, learns the household's routines and feelings, works happily inside the pack's rules, and wants, above all, to belong and be useful.

nodes.label: Domestic cat
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Felidae > Felis catus
nodes.lore_note: A self-reliant, sensory craftsman: it masters its territory alone, hunts for the pleasure of the technique, accepts affection strictly on its own schedule, and answers to no pack, plan or person.

nodes.label: Horse
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Perissodactyla > Family Equidae > Equus caballus
nodes.lore_note: A gentle, dutiful herd-member: it learns its work thoroughly, remembers every kindness and fright, keeps faithfully to the group and its routines, and wants predictability and quiet competence from life.

nodes.label: Domestic pig
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Artiodactyla > Family Suidae > Sus scrofa domesticus
nodes.lore_note: An inventive, nose-led opportunist: it experiments on everything — gates, feeders, other pigs' intentions — learns the system fast, and treats every rule of the pen as a puzzle with food behind it.

nodes.label: Domestic cow
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Artiodactyla > Family Bovidae > Bos taurus
nodes.lore_note: A calm, loyal herd-member: it keeps its friendships, learns the farm's routines by heart, cares intensely for its calf and its companions, and asks for a predictable, unhurried world.

nodes.label: Lion
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Felidae > Panthera leo
nodes.lore_note: A commanding pride-sovereign: it organises hunts, holds territory by presence and proclamation, rests like it owns the day — because, socially, it does — and treats status as the central fact of life.

nodes.label: Tiger
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Felidae > Panthera tigris
nodes.lore_note: A lone, territorial master of its craft: it patrols a private kingdom by scent and memory, hunts alone at night, and treats every other adult of its kind as a negotiation it would rather not have.

nodes.label: Brown bear
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Ursidae > Ursus arctos
nodes.lore_note: A self-sufficient seasonal craftsman: it follows its nose and its private food calendar, solves problems alone, fishes, digs and engineers its year around abundance — then sleeps through the lean part.

nodes.label: Giant panda
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Ursidae > Ailuropoda melanoleuca
nodes.lore_note: A quiet, gentle specialist living entirely in the present season: it follows the bamboo, marks its posts, eats and rests at its own unhurried pace, and wants company only in one brief week of the year.

nodes.label: Red kangaroo
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Diprotodontia > Family Macropodidae > Macropus rufus
nodes.lore_note: A physical, present-tense mob animal: it grazes, scans, hops and boxes in the open with its companions, lives by the day's water and grass, and keeps its considerable cleverness in its body and timing.

nodes.label: Koala
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Diprotodontia > Family Phascolarctidae > Phascolarctos cinereus
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, unbothered specialist: it masters exactly one craft — eucalypts — sleeps through everything else, defends its trees when pressed, and has no interest whatsoever in broadening its horizons.

nodes.label: Platypus
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Monotremata > Family Ornithorhynchidae > Ornithorhynchus anatinus
nodes.lore_note: A shy, solitary sensory craftsman: it hunts alone in dark water by a sense nothing else in its world shares, trusts its bill over its eyes, and disappears into its burrow at the first disturbance.

nodes.label: Short-beaked echidna
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Monotremata > Family Tachyglossidae > Tachyglossus aculeatus
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, systematic forager with a private long game: it works its rounds methodically, digs straight to what it wants, learns quietly, and keeps its unexpectedly large mind entirely to itself.

nodes.label: Spotted hyena
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Hyaenidae > Crocuta crocuta
nodes.lore_note: A commanding clan politician: it tracks a hundred ranks and alliances, organises hunts and mobbing by the numbers, laughs its status across the savanna, and plays the long social game better than any carnivore here.

nodes.label: Meerkat
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Herpestidae > Suricata suricatta
nodes.lore_note: A tireless communal carer: it stands sentinel for the group, babysits others' pups, teaches the young its craft step by step, and organises its whole life around the mob's rota.

nodes.label: Naked mole-rat
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Rodentia > Family Bathyergidae > Heterocephalus glaber
nodes.lore_note: A dutiful colony worker in a sealed city: it digs, hauls, guards and tends by caste and routine, keeps the tunnels exactly as they should be, and subordinates every individual preference to the colony's order.

nodes.label: Common vampire bat
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Chiroptera > Family Phyllostomidae > Desmodus rotundus
nodes.lore_note: A devoted roost-mate with a perfect memory for kindness: it shares its own meals with hungry friends, remembers exactly who helped it before, and keeps the colony's web of debts warm and current.

nodes.label: Indian flying fox
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Chiroptera > Family Pteropodidae > Pteropus giganteus
nodes.lore_note: A sociable night-wanderer: it roosts in a noisy crowd of thousands, then flies out alone under the stars to whichever remembered tree is fruiting, curious, mobile and impossible to fence in.

nodes.label: Brown-throated sloth
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Pilosa > Family Bradypodidae > Bradypus variegatus
nodes.lore_note: A gentle, unhurried solitary living entirely at its own pace: it savours its trees, minds its own canopy, moves only when moving is worth it, and has made an art form of needing almost nothing.

nodes.label: European hedgehog
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Eulipotyphla > Family Erinaceidae > Erinaceus europaeus
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, practical night-patroller: it follows its nose through its rounds, investigates everything edible, curls up on its own resources when threatened, and keeps its social life to the bare minimum.

nodes.label: Brown rat
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Rodentia > Family Muridae > Rattus norvegicus
nodes.lore_note: A wary, tireless systems-experimenter: it maps the whole warren and city in its head, tests every new food and passage cautiously, learns from everyone's mistakes, and trusts data over boldness every time.

nodes.label: House mouse
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Rodentia > Family Muridae > Mus musculus
nodes.lore_note: A small, wary opportunist-engineer: it maps its walls and warrens precisely, tests everything cautiously, sings ultrasonically for love, and survives by being quick, quiet and hard to predict.

nodes.label: American beaver
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Rodentia > Family Castoridae > Castor canadensis
nodes.lore_note: A dutiful master-builder: it maintains its dam and lodge by nightly routine, defends its pond with scent-posted borders, raises its family inside walls it built itself, and fixes any leak it hears, immediately.

nodes.label: Raccoon
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Procyonidae > Procyon lotor
nodes.lore_note: A mischievous tactile inventor: it investigates the world hand-first, cracks latches and puzzles for the fun of the mechanism, remembers every solution, and treats every human 'raccoon-proof' claim as a personal challenge.

nodes.label: North American river otter
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Carnivora > Family Mustelidae > Lontra canadensis
nodes.lore_note: A joyful, physical performer-fisher: it plays as hard as it hunts, slides and wrestles with its family, explores its whole river with gusto, and treats every bank as a potential playground.

nodes.label: European rabbit
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Lagomorpha > Family Leporidae > Oryctolagus cuniculus
nodes.lore_note: A devoted warren-keeper: it grazes close to home with its family, keeps the group's routines and hierarchies, raises kits communally, and puts the safety of the burrow above every adventure.

nodes.label: Virginia opossum
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Didelphimorphia > Family Didelphidae > Didelphis virginiana
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, unflappable scavenger-survivor: it wanders its night routes alone, eats whatever the night offers, endures what it cannot fight, and when all else fails its body plays dead entirely without asking it.

nodes.label: Hippopotamus
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Artiodactyla > Family Hippopotamidae > Hippopotamus amphibius
nodes.lore_note: A territorial river-landlord run on strict routine: it holds its stretch of water absolutely, walks the same ancestral paths to graze each night, keeps the pod in order, and tolerates no trespass in its domain.

nodes.label: Dromedary camel
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Artiodactyla > Family Camelidae > Camelus dromedarius
nodes.lore_note: A stoic, methodical desert professional: it learns its routes and handlers thoroughly, remembers them for years, manages its water and energy by strict internal budget, and endures conditions nothing else in this batch could cross.

nodes.label: Llama
nodes.address: Class Mammalia > Order Artiodactyla > Family Camelidae > Lama glama
nodes.lore_note: A vigilant herd-guardian and companion: it keeps watch over its group — even an adopted flock of sheep — hums its feelings to everyone nearby, remembers its people and pastures, and charges trouble on the herd's behalf.

nodes.label: Peregrine falcon
nodes.lore_note: A solitary, precision athlete: it waits, reads the sky, and solves the interception problem with its whole body in one committed move.

nodes.label: Bald eagle
nodes.lore_note: A territorial executive of the shoreline: it holds a huge eyrie, defends a domain, follows seasonal routines, and appropriates others' catches as a matter of policy.

nodes.label: Snowy owl
nodes.lore_note: A solitary strategist of scarcity: it commits its breeding year entirely on a read of prey cycles, hunts alone, and relocates without sentiment when the numbers change.

nodes.label: Emperor penguin
nodes.lore_note: A provider in a crowd: it fasts for its chick, takes its turn on the freezing edge of the huddle, and finds its family by voice — care and duty are the whole strategy.

nodes.label: Common ostrich
nodes.lore_note: A big, social, physical presence: it lives in company, settles matters with display and a kick, trusts its eyes and legs, and improvises around a simple, effective plan.

nodes.label: North Island brown kiwi
nodes.lore_note: A quiet, solitary-souled night worker: it keeps to its own forest territory with one long-term partner, follows scent and feeling over sight, and shuns the daytime world entirely.

nodes.label: Ruby-throated hummingbird
nodes.lore_note: All engine and nerve: it lives at full throttle, picks fights with rivals many times its weight class in spirit, and treats every flower patch as turf to be won and held.

nodes.label: Scarlet macaw
nodes.lore_note: A flamboyant social enthusiast: it travels, calls, plays and displays in company, bonds for life, and turns every dawn roost departure into a public event.

nodes.label: African grey parrot
nodes.lore_note: A concept-driven learner: Alex's documented work was categorising the world — what colour, what shape, what's same, what's different — the behaviour of a mind that sorts reality for its own sake, with a sensitive, easily stressed social side (hence the INFP runner-up).

nodes.label: New Caledonian crow
nodes.lore_note: An engineer by temperament: confronted with food in a tube, it does not wait for luck — it fabricates the instrument, tests it, and keeps the good ones.

nodes.label: Eurasian magpie
nodes.lore_note: A showy improviser: it investigates everything shiny or new, argues its rank in public, steals strategically, and treats the neighbourhood as a debate it intends to win.

nodes.label: Rock pigeon
nodes.lore_note: A loyal homebody: it bonds to one loft and one mate, flies extraordinary distances to return to them, keeps the flock's routines, and asks only for a ledge and seed.

nodes.label: Wandering albatross
nodes.lore_note: A faithful solitary pilgrim: years alone over empty ocean, one lifelong partner, one island home returned to across decades — a life of long patience and single deep attachments.

nodes.label: Komodo dragon
nodes.lore_note: A lone physical operator: it patrols, samples the air, picks its moment, and relies on its own body and endurance — no pack, no display, no negotiation beyond dominance.

nodes.label: Green anaconda
nodes.lore_note: A long-game ambusher: it selects a station, waits submerged for days on a calculation of where prey must come to drink, and acts once, completely.

nodes.label: American alligator
nodes.lore_note: A steadfast territorial provider: it maintains its hole and nest by routine, answers its young's calls without fail, and settles disputes by established size and display.

nodes.label: Leatherback sea turtle
nodes.lore_note: A gentle, solitary traveller: it harms almost nothing but jellyfish, follows its own quiet routes across whole oceans, and returns faithfully to its birth beach.

nodes.label: Panther chameleon
nodes.lore_note: A solitary observer: it surveys everything from stillness, signals instead of socialising, and solves the prey problem with optics and one precise mechanism.

nodes.label: Nile crocodile
nodes.lore_note: A dominant enforcer of river order: it holds a stretch, takes its ranked place at kills, runs the crossing season like an institution, and brooks no trespass at the nest.

nodes.label: Gila monster
nodes.lore_note: A self-reliant loner on a strict budget: it emerges rarely, follows its nose to a nest, eats enormously, and disappears underground again on its own schedule.

nodes.label: King cobra
nodes.lore_note: A focused strategist of a single niche: it plans its hunts around other snakes' habits, confronts threats deliberately rather than fleeing blindly, and (the female) invests in a built nest no other snake bothers with.

nodes.label: Axolotl
nodes.lore_note: A soft, unhurried dreamer of the canal bottom: it never grows into its adult form, keeps to itself, startles easily, and quietly regrows whatever life takes from it.

nodes.label: Golden poison frog
nodes.lore_note: A tiny showman with nothing to fear: it advertises in gold, sings for territory and mates in public, and acts first because its chemistry guarantees it can.

nodes.label: Cane toad
nodes.lore_note: An opportunistic expansionist: no niche is refused, no habitat beneath it, every waterhole a launchpad — it improvises an invasion out of appetite and legs.

nodes.label: Japanese giant salamander
nodes.lore_note: A dutiful den-keeper: it holds one stretch of stream for years, maintains its burrow, guards its eggs with monastic patience, and meets the world on a decades-long schedule.

nodes.label: Great white shark
nodes.lore_note: A solitary professional: it patrols alone, strikes from below with total commitment, follows a seasonal circuit of its own, and shares a carcass only on its own terms.

nodes.label: Whale shark
nodes.lore_note: A gentle, unhurried solitary: it bothers nothing, follows the plankton seasons at its own pace, tolerates company at feeding sites, and drifts on.

nodes.label: Giant manta ray
nodes.lore_note: A curious, gentle socialiser: it investigates divers, returns to favourite cleaning stations like a regular to a salon, and feeds in looping company with its own kind.

nodes.label: Atlantic salmon
nodes.lore_note: A dutiful pilgrim of duty: it keeps one appointment made in childhood, crosses an ocean and climbs waterfalls to keep it, and gives everything to the next generation in its home gravel.

nodes.label: Clownfish (common / ocellaris)
nodes.lore_note: A devoted homemaker in a strict household: it tends its anemone, keeps its ranked place in the family queue, feeds and defends its eggs, and builds its whole life around home and housemates.

nodes.label: Lined seahorse
nodes.lore_note: A shy, devoted keeper of a tiny home: one partner greeted daily, one grass patch held faithfully, eggs carried with literal bodily care by the male.

nodes.label: Coelacanth (West Indian Ocean)
nodes.lore_note: A solitary deep-water minimalist: it keeps its cave, hunts alone at night by senses we barely share, and has refined doing very little, very slowly, to perfection.

nodes.label: Electric eel
nodes.lore_note: An experimenter with a built-in laboratory: it probes hidden prey with crafted pulses to make the invisible reveal itself — applied physics as a hunting style, documented in the lab.

nodes.label: Banded archerfish
nodes.lore_note: A marksman-engineer: it solves a physics problem (refraction, gravity, moving prey) with a tool made of water, practises, and steals lessons by watching the best shooter in the group.

nodes.label: Cleaner wrasse (common / bluestreak)
nodes.lore_note: A service professional to the core: it tends a queue of clients (including predators), keeps its reputation clean by performing honesty in public, and runs its station like a beloved family business.

nodes.label: Goldfish
nodes.lore_note: A cheerful, curious companion: it greets feeding time with enthusiasm, explores every corner and plant, learns the household routine, and lives for company and snacks.

nodes.label: Caenorhabditis elegans
nodes.address: Phylum Nematoda > Class Chromadorea > Family Rhabditidae > Caenorhabditis elegans
nodes.lore_note: A minimal, fully legible experimenter: it samples gradients, updates preferences from outcomes, and carries no social or territorial overhead at all.

nodes.label: Common fruit fly
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Diptera > Family Drosophilidae > Drosophila melanogaster
nodes.lore_note: An opportunistic social explorer: it rushes to novelty (fermenting fruit, new mates), learns the room in minutes, and communicates excitement chemically and acoustically to the crowd around the food.

nodes.label: Portia jumping spider
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Arachnida > Order Araneae > Family Salticidae > Portia africana
nodes.lore_note: A solitary strategist that reconnoitres, builds a bespoke plan for each victim, and patiently revises the plan from feedback until the trap closes.

nodes.label: Common cuttlefish
nodes.address: Phylum Mollusca > Class Cephalopoda > Order Sepiida > Family Sepiidae > Sepia officinalis
nodes.lore_note: A cool, visual tactician: solitary, camouflaged, it watches first, strikes precisely, and lets its skin do the talking — every display is calculated and reversible.

nodes.label: Peacock mantis shrimp
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Subphylum Crustacea > Order Stomatopoda > Family Odontodactylidae > Odontodactylus scyllarus
nodes.lore_note: A territorial sentinel that trusts its senses absolutely: observe from the burrow mouth, judge in an instant, and if the judgement is 'intruder', end the argument with a single explosive act.

nodes.label: Leafcutter ant
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Hymenoptera > Family Formicidae > Atta cephalotes
nodes.lore_note: The colony as tireless operations manager: division of labour, supply lines, quality control of the fungus crop — everything organised, everything for the collective store.

nodes.label: Macrotermes termite (colony)
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Blattodea > Family Termitidae > Macrotermes bellicosus
nodes.lore_note: The colony as patient infrastructure-keeper: maintain the climate, tend the garden, repair the walls — duty performed identically for decades without novelty or display.

nodes.label: Monarch butterfly
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Lepidoptera > Family Nymphalidae > Danaus plexippus
nodes.lore_note: A gentle, single-minded traveller: no territory, no aggression, just colour, nectar and an unshakeable southward heading when the season turns.

nodes.label: Common earthworm
nodes.address: Phylum Annelida > Class Clitellata > Family Lumbricidae > Lumbricus terrestris
nodes.lore_note: A methodical soil-keeper: same burrow, same nightly rounds, leaves pulled in by the correct end — quiet, routine, indispensable work done in the dark.

nodes.label: Immortal jellyfish
nodes.address: Phylum Cnidaria > Class Hydrozoa > Family Oceaniidae > Turritopsis dohrnii
nodes.lore_note: If a type must be pinned to a nerve net, it is the quiet survivor: no plans, no territory — endure, drift, and when the form fails, become the earlier self and begin again. (Design metaphor — see Confidence.)

nodes.label: Australian box jellyfish
nodes.address: Phylum Cnidaria > Class Cubozoa > Order Chirodropida > Family Chirodropidae > Chironex fleckeri
nodes.lore_note: A watchful drifter-hunter: solitary, eyes open, course corrected by what it sees — act on the visual evidence, sting first if anything touches the tentacles. (Read on a brainless system — design metaphor, see Confidence.)

nodes.label: Giant barrel sponge
nodes.address: Phylum Porifera > Class Demospongiae > Family Petrosiidae > Xestospongia muta
nodes.lore_note: Pinned only as a design metaphor (see Confidence): the ultimate patient fixture — stay, filter, endure, repair. If a sponge has a 'style', it is permanence itself.

nodes.label: Hydra
nodes.address: Phylum Cnidaria > Class Hydrozoa > Family Hydridae > Hydra vulgaris
nodes.lore_note: A spare, self-repairing opportunist: sit, sway, sting what brushes past, regrow whatever is lost. (Design metaphor for a nerve-net animal — see Confidence.)

nodes.label: Mediterranean planarian
nodes.address: Phylum Platyhelminthes > Class Rhabditophora > Order Tricladida > Family Dugesiidae > Schmidtea mediterranea
nodes.lore_note: A retiring, light-shy learner: it explores by taste and touch, retreats from brightness, and quietly retains what it has learned through transformations that should have erased it. (Read weighted by its famous reticence and persistence.)

nodes.label: Physarum slime mould
nodes.address: Supergroup Amoebozoa > Class Myxogastria > Order Physarales > Family Physaraceae > Physarum polycephalum
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as an explicit design metaphor (see Confidence): a tireless network experimenter — extend a probe, measure the flow, prune what fails, keep the shortest path. It is the purest 'try and revise' system in the Atlas.

nodes.label: Venus flytrap
nodes.address: Kingdom Plantae > Order Caryophyllales > Family Droseraceae > Dionaea muscipula
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): a patient, rule-bound ambusher — nothing wasted, nothing chased; the rule is the rule, and it is executed in a tenth of a second.

nodes.label: Sensitive plant
nodes.address: Kingdom Plantae > Order Fabales > Family Fabaceae > Mimosa pudica
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): the shrinking violet made literal — exquisitely touch-sensitive, it withdraws completely at contact and returns only when all is calm.

nodes.label: Giant sequoia
nodes.address: Kingdom Plantae > Division Pinophyta > Family Cupressaceae > Sequoiadendron giganteum
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): permanence as a strategy — thick bark, deep patience, reproduction scheduled around disasters lesser lives flee from.

nodes.label: Honey fungus
nodes.address: Kingdom Fungi > Phylum Basidiomycota > Family Physalacriaceae > Armillaria ostoyae
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): inexorable, subterranean expansion — no display, no haste, territory taken centimetre by centimetre and held for millennia.

nodes.label: Baker's yeast
nodes.address: Kingdom Fungi > Phylum Ascomycota > Family Saccharomycetaceae > Saccharomyces cerevisiae
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): a small sensualist — follow the sweetness, lean toward the mate's scent, and when times turn hard, seal up and wait.

nodes.label: Escherichia coli
nodes.address: Domain Bacteria > Phylum Pseudomonadota > Family Enterobacteriaceae > Escherichia coli
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): a pure reactor — sample, compare, move; no plans, no attachments, just exquisite responsiveness to change.

nodes.label: Medicinal leech
nodes.address: Phylum Annelida > Class Clitellata > Order Arhynchobdellida > Family Hirudinidae > Hirudo medicinalis
nodes.lore_note: A patient tactile specialist: wait in the shallows, read the ripples, attach without being noticed, and hold on. Sensation-led, unhurried, solitary.

nodes.label: California sea hare
nodes.address: Phylum Mollusca > Class Gastropoda > Order Aplysiida > Family Aplysiidae > Aplysia californica
nodes.lore_note: A gentle, defensive grazer whose whole documented inner life is learning what is safe: touch it kindly and it relaxes its guard; hurt it once and it remembers for weeks. Caution earned by experience, exactly as measured.

nodes.label: Great pond snail
nodes.address: Phylum Mollusca > Class Gastropoda > Family Lymnaeidae > Lymnaea stagnalis
nodes.lore_note: A cautious, home-water learner: surface carefully, breathe, remember what the water smelled like when it was dangerous, and adjust. Routine and vigilance in a shell.

nodes.label: Buff-tailed bumblebee
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Hymenoptera > Family Apidae > Bombus terrestris
nodes.lore_note: A sociable enthusiast-learner: quick to try, quick to copy a neighbour's bright idea, tireless between flowers — curiosity with a colony behind it.

nodes.label: European hornet
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Hymenoptera > Family Vespidae > Vespa crabro
nodes.lore_note: A formidable but orderly colony citizen-soldier: hunt by the shift, defend the nest without hesitation, keep the paper city running until autumn ends it.

nodes.label: Atlantic horseshoe crab
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Subphylum Chelicerata > Class Merostomata > Order Xiphosura > Limulus polyphemus
nodes.lore_note: A tide-timed traditionalist: same beaches, same spring tides, same ancient routine for eons — perceive precisely, act seasonally, change nothing that works. (Read from documented behaviour; cognition beyond vision is thin and the record admits it.)

nodes.label: Purple sea urchin
nodes.address: Phylum Echinodermata > Class Echinoidea > Family Strongylocentrotidae > Strongylocentrotus purpuratus
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): a slow sensory wanderer — drift toward what tastes good, cover up when exposed, persist. No centre, no plan, real preferences.

nodes.label: Common starfish
nodes.address: Phylum Echinodermata > Class Asteroidea > Order Forcipulatida > Family Asteriidae > Asterias rubens
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): an unhurried sensory explorer — feel the way forward with five independent hands, commit when the chemistry says food.

nodes.label: American cockroach
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Blattodea > Family Blattidae > Periplaneta americana
nodes.lore_note: A pragmatic escape artist: exquisitely alert to threat, otherwise an unbothered opportunist that learns the building better than its owners know it.

nodes.label: Two-spotted cricket
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Class Insecta > Order Orthoptera > Family Gryllidae > Gryllus bimaculatus
nodes.lore_note: A singing competitor: it advertises by song, fights for the burrow mouth, learns fast what pays, and bounces back from defeat when the chemistry resets.

nodes.label: Chambered nautilus
nodes.address: Phylum Mollusca > Class Cephalopoda > Subclass Nautiloidea > Family Nautilidae > Nautilus pompilius
nodes.lore_note: A deep-water scavenger of few needs and long patience: drift up at night, follow the scent, take what the reef lets fall — and quietly remember what the light once meant.

nodes.label: Longfin inshore squid
nodes.address: Phylum Mollusca > Class Cephalopoda > Order Myopsida > Family Loliginidae > Doryteuthis pealeii
nodes.lore_note: A fast, social sprinter: live in the school, signal on the skin, strike and jet in one motion — sensation and speed over solitary scheming.

nodes.label: Edible crab
nodes.address: Phylum Arthropoda > Subphylum Crustacea > Order Decapoda > Family Cancridae > Cancer pagurus
nodes.lore_note: A methodical shore-keeper: work the same ground nightly, test everything with the antennules first, back into a crevice claws-out when the reading is bad.

nodes.label: Trichoplax
nodes.address: Phylum Placozoa > Class Uniplacotomia > Family Trichoplacidae > Trichoplax adhaerens
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): drift, settle where it tastes right, stay a while. Nothing else has ever been required of it in half a billion years of lineage.

nodes.label: Dictyostelium
nodes.address: Supergroup Amoebozoa > Class Dictyostelidida > Family Dictyosteliidae > Dictyostelium discoideum
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): the ultimate community organiser — when crisis comes it literally calls the neighbourhood together, builds the structure, and gives up its own cells for the group's future.

nodes.label: Stentor
nodes.address: Supergroup SAR > Phylum Ciliophora > Family Stentoridae > Stentor coeruleus
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): a self-sufficient loner with clear boundaries — tolerate, deflect, flinch, and if it keeps happening, leave and rebuild elsewhere.

nodes.label: Paramecium
nodes.address: Supergroup SAR > Phylum Ciliophora > Family Parameciidae > Paramecium caudatum
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): pure responsive motion — bump, back, turn, go; a life of immediate feedback with no residue.

nodes.label: Vase tunicate
nodes.address: Phylum Chordata > Subphylum Tunicata > Class Ascidiacea > Family Cionidae > Ciona intestinalis
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): explore young, choose once, settle forever — a life in two acts, wanderer then fixture, each with exactly the nervous system it needs.

nodes.label: Sea walnut
nodes.address: Phylum Ctenophora > Class Tentaculata > Order Lobata > Family Bolinopsidae > Mnemiopsis leidyi
nodes.lore_note: Pinned as a design metaphor (see Confidence): a luminous drifter — comb the water, glow when touched, take what the currents deliver, in a body plan older than brains twice-invented.
